summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a board meeting scheduled for May 13, 2026 to consider and approve unaudited Q1 2026 quarterly results, along with a corresponding earnings conference call. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special-situation event. The filing includes a press release with conference call details and registration links. No transaction terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics are present. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is a routine current report under Rule 13a-16. What to watch: N/A.
